qa_lessons: Physical contact-count and seating checks do not catch coplanar decorative caps: final shading views exposed an inherited hidden-core/topcap overlap; original hidden cores were lowered 1 mm, regressions added and all final previews regenerated.
Blender scripts use --python-exit-code 1 because Python exceptions can otherwise coexist with process exit 0; verify actual report and test output.
Generic visual similarity is not permission to merge source versions: GTAI manual2.31 and website2.21 service populations are separate.
